title: If the Sea Were Ink, It Would Still Run Out

meta.name: v5_k18_15_the-ink
meta.title: If the Sea Were Ink, It Would Still Run Out

lines.text: If the sea were ink, it would still run out.
Think of every ocean as ink.
If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement.

quran.ar: لَّوۡ كَانَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادࣰا لِّكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّی لَنَفِدَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَـٰتُ رَبِّی وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهِۦ مَدَدࣰا

lines.text: So stay humble about what you know.
